pooled_caveat: This is a heterogeneous criticism cluster rather than a coherent policy program; some samples also state preferred alternatives, historical comparisons, or narrow sovereignty objections.
pooled_summary: The central claims criticize or reject administrations, public institutions, international bodies, and opposing-party policies across fiscal, constitutional, military, trade, social, and foreign-affairs questions. Unlike a record-centered cluster, these claims are organized mainly by oppositional judgments and objections to policy direction or institutional authority.
qualification: Source-bound assistant synthesis of period- and document-diverse central examples, not independent human certification or an exhaustive stance classification. Statements describe the observed documents across years, not every member's beliefs or a current consensus.
title: Cross-Policy Opposition and Institutional Critiques
